description: Chaos generator with no chaos parameter: the shape and sound of the Gingerbread Man map come from its starting values, which the Reseed button and input reroll

params.text: Sets how often a new value is generated
Attenuverter for the S. Rate CV input, -1 to +1
Sets how much of the previous output is added to the generation rate, so the map modulates its own speed
Attenuverter for the Feedback FM CV input, -1 to +1
Fast runs the generator across its full rate range; Slow divides that rate by 100 for modulation speeds
Stepped jumps to each new value; Slewed interpolates linearly between values, which doubles as a low-pass filter at audio rates
DC passes the output as generated; AC strips any DC offset out of it
Rerolls the map's starting values, which changes the shape it traces and how it sounds

inputs.text: A rising edge here generates one new value, replacing the internal rate clock
A rising edge here rerolls the map's starting values
Modulates the generation rate, scaled by the S. Rate attenuverter
Modulates the feedback amount, scaled by the Feedback FM attenuverter

notes: the generation rate is set as a fraction of the patch's own sample rate, so changing the patch's sample rate changes the speed and the sound of what comes out.
